newsitem.title: USA: Smithway Motor acquires Pirie Motor assets.
newsitem.headline: Smithway Motor acquires Pirie Motor assets.

text.p: Smithway Motor Xpress Corp said Tuesday it acquired the tractors, trailers and certain other assets of Pirie Motor Freight Inc of Fort Dodge, Iowa.

In exchange, Smithway assumed and repaid about $1.3 million in equipment financing secured by the tractors and trailers. It also paid a percentage of revenue for a noncompetition and consulting arrangmeent.
Pirie Motor generated about $2.8 million in 1996 revenue.
Smithway, a truckload carrier that hauls diversified freight nationwide, said this is its fourth acquisition since May 1995 and the second since its initial public offering in June 1996.
